entities.name: Pitdown
entities.description: One of the twelve Southern City-States of Terisiare during the Dark Age.

entities.name: Alsoor
entities.description: Neighboring city-state whose army fought at Pitdown.

entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: Neighboring city-state whose army fought at Pitdown.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Three-way battle between Alsoor, Ghed and goblin raiders.

entities.name: Lady Ursnell
entities.description: Fashioned the Bone Flute from Lord Ursnell's leg.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Fled the battle and drank from the Fountain of Youth.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where Pitdown lies.

entities.name: Fountain of Youth
entities.description: Neglected fountain in Pitdown's square whose water healed Jodah and stopped his aging.

events.summary: The armies of Alsoor and Ghed meet goblin raiders in the Battle of Pitdown and many die.
Lady Ursnell fashions the Bone Flute out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.
events.quote: Lady Ursnell fashioned the Bone Flute out of Lord Ursnell’s left leg.

events.summary: Hiding from goblin raiders, Jodah accidentally drinks from the Fountain of Youth.
events.quote: Jodah accidentally drank some of its water

relations.quote: Pitdown was situated on the eastern coast of Terisiare
